g.text: All values are regret as % of trace instructions.
Random averages all five fixed seeds; seeds are not population replicates.
B Secondary budget sensitivity · same row order
Cap 64 LUT4 · measured feasibility required · lower regret is better · baseline saved instructions = 0
Four primary source families; descriptive fixed-cohort results, no population confidence intervals. Benefit and regret use an overlap-safe retired-instruction-count proxy; no CPU speedup claim.
Six model policies prioritize predicted-feasible candidates by merit. Merit/frequency/random use the same candidate pools and attempt budgets.
